title: Involutions
key_idea: An **involution** is a permutation $w$ with $w^2 = \text{id}$ (every cycle has length 1 or 2). Counting involutions by fixed points, descents, and other statistics uses the I-E framework from §2.1–2.2. The EGF for involutions is $e^{x + x^2/2}$.
